history.meta.title: Our story | JEBA
history.title: A story built around learning by doing.
history.lead: JEBA was born at Politecnico di Bari from students who wanted to turn university education into hands-on experience, building a bridge between university, companies and the local community.
history.story.title: From classrooms to real experiences.
history.story.p1: JEBA, Junior Enterprise Bari, was founded in 2021 and is the first Junior Enterprise in Puglia. From the beginning, the project has been built around learning by doing: putting knowledge into practice through real projects, initiatives and collaborations.
history.story.p2: The idea is simple: growth does not happen only through books. It happens when skills, people and real problems meet. That is why JEBA creates opportunities for students to take responsibility, collaborate and engage with the professional world.
history.timeline.title: The moments that brought us here.
history.timeline.intro: A simple timeline to tell JEBA’s evolution, always keeping the people who make it possible at the centre of the story.
history.timeline.2021.title: JEBA is born
history.timeline.2021.text: A group of Politecnico di Bari students launches the first Junior Enterprise in Puglia.
history.timeline.today.title: Today
